_comment: Hand-maintained catalysts. ClinicalTrials.gov does not carry PDUFA dates, earnings dates, or plain-language outcomes, so these live here. Edit this file to add or correct events; run `npm run build` to regenerate the site data.

MRNA.name: Moderna, Inc.
MRNA.note: Clinical-stage vaccine and therapeutics developer. Catalysts are trial readouts, FDA decisions, and earnings.

ILMN.name: Illumina, Inc.
ILMN.note: Genomics tools and diagnostics company, not a drug developer. Catalysts are regulatory clearances, reimbursement decisions, platform launches, and earnings.

events.title: Intismeran + KEYTRUDA — 5-Year Phase 2b Melanoma Data
events.summary: Five-year follow-up from the adjuvant melanoma cohort, presented in an oral session at the ASCO 2026 Annual Meeting.
events.result: Sustained benefit: intismeran combined with KEYTRUDA reduced the risk of recurrence or death by 49% versus KEYTRUDA alone.

events.title: mFLUSIVA (mRNA-1010) — FDA Advisory Committee Vote
events.summary: The Vaccines and Related Biological Products Advisory Committee reviewed the benefit-risk profile of the seasonal influenza vaccine for adults 50 and older.
events.result: Voted 9-0 that benefits outweigh risks for adults 50-64, and separately 9-0 for adults 65 and older.

events.title: Q2 2026 Earnings + Norovirus Interim Analysis
events.summary: Quarterly results reported alongside a Phase 3 interim analysis for the norovirus vaccine candidate mRNA-1403.
events.result: Q2 revenue $0.1B, GAAP EPS -$1.97. mRNA-1403 did not meet statistical criteria for early success at the interim; an additional cohort is being enrolled. FY26 opex outlook improved by ~$0.2B.

events.title: mFLUSIVA (mRNA-1010) — FDA PDUFA Decision
events.summary: FDA target action date for the seasonal influenza vaccine BLA in adults 50 and older, following a February 2026 refusal-to-file that was reversed after a Type A meeting.
events.result: Approved — the first mRNA-based seasonal flu vaccine licensed in the US. The 65+ indication was granted accelerated approval contingent on a postmarketing study spanning two flu seasons. Phase 3 showed 26.6% relative vaccine efficacy vs a standard-dose comparator.

events.title: Intismeran Autogene — Phase 3 INTerpath-001 (Melanoma)
events.summary: Pivotal adjuvant high-risk melanoma trial run with Merck in over 1,100 patients, testing the personalized mRNA cancer vaccine alongside KEYTRUDA.
events.result: Met primary and key secondary endpoints — the first positive Phase 3 readout for an mRNA cancer therapy. MRNA rose 177% intraday, then gave back roughly 8% the following session.

events.title: Q3 2026 Earnings
events.summary: Quarterly results and pipeline update. Management guided that Q3 should represent roughly 55% of second-half revenue. Watch for firmer timing on the propionic acidemia and mRNA-4359 readouts.

events.title: mRNA-4359 — Phase 2 Cancer Antigen Therapy Readout
events.summary: Wholly-owned cancer antigen therapy designed to elicit T-cell responses against tumor and immunosuppressive cells. Phase 2 includes first-line and second-line+ metastatic melanoma and first-line metastatic NSCLC cohorts.
events.source: Moderna Analyst Day — guided to 2026, exact date unconfirmed

events.title: Propionic Acidemia (mRNA-3927) — Registrational Data
events.summary: Rare disease therapeutic. Target enrollment has been reached in the registrational study. A decision on the sister MMA program (mRNA-3705) is being deferred until this reads out.
events.source: Moderna Q2 2026 update — guided to 2026, exact date unconfirmed

events.title: Dr. Eric Green Appointed Chief Medical Officer
events.summary: Former NHGRI director named CMO to lead global medical strategy and expand clinical adoption of genomics.
events.result: Appointment confirmed, effective February 2, 2026, reporting to the CEO.

events.title: TruSight Oncology Comprehensive — CMS Reimbursement
events.summary: Medicare reimbursement granted for the FDA-approved in vitro diagnostic, opening access across hospitals and regional reference labs.
events.result: Effective January 1, 2026, reimbursed under the Clinical Laboratory Fee Schedule at $2,989.55 via PLA code 0543U.

events.title: SomaLogic & Sengenics Acquisition Closed
events.summary: Acquisition from Standard BioTools completed, expanding the proteomics and multiomics portfolio.
events.result: Closed January 30, 2026, funded with cash on hand.

events.title: Daniel Skovronsky (Lilly CSO) Joins Board
events.summary: Eli Lilly's Chief Scientific and Product Officer appointed to the Board, adding drug development and translational medicine perspective.

events.title: Q2 2026 Earnings
events.summary: Clinical sequencing strength and NovaSeq X adoption were the stated growth drivers.
events.result: Revenue approximately $1.16B with non-GAAP EPS near $1.31. FY2026 revenue guidance raised to $4.60-4.64B. Net margin compressed year over year.

events.title: Q3 2026 Earnings
events.summary: Watch for clinical consumables growth, MRD and comprehensive genomic profiling reimbursement progress, and China export-control commentary.
events.source: Estimated from historical reporting cadence — not yet confirmed
